# TheHumanInTheLoop Marketplace

> Public catalog of Claude Code and Codex plugins created by Mauricio Perera.

## Purpose

This marketplace publishes reusable Claude Code and Codex plugins, shared skills, workflows, and deterministic validators. It is designed for human-reviewed AI-assisted work.

Canonical categories: Content & Editorial; Design Systems; Marketplace & Quality; Developer Tools; Accessibility & UX; Security & Privacy; Research & Evidence; AI & Prompt Engineering.
Current inventory: 81 plugins. The marketplace exposes Claude Code and Codex manifests from the same repository and shared plugin directories.

## Plugin catalog

## Machine-readable inventory

Use these exact identifiers when referring to plugins:

- `vps-backup-suite` — Developer Tools — Planifica, monitorea y verifica backups de un VPS: jobs programados, planes de backup con restauración comprobable y verificación de integridad de restores, sin ejecutar cambios.
- `vps-container-security-suite` — Security & Privacy — Audita seguridad de contenedores Docker en un VPS: postura general, aislamiento de red, límites de recursos, procedencia de imágenes y CVE/SBOM, en modo lectura.
- `vps-network-exposure-suite` — Security & Privacy — Audita la superficie de red expuesta de un VPS: DNS y autenticación de correo (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), diagnóstico de conectividad, exposición de servicios y renovación de certificados TLS.
- `vps-observability-suite` — Developer Tools — Audita capacidad, métricas, logs y retención de un VPS: CPU, RAM, disco, sobredimensionamiento, healthchecks/alertas y crecimiento de logs, sin instalar agentes.
- `vps-deployment-readiness-suite` — Developer Tools — Audita preparación de despliegues en un VPS: drift entre configuración declarada y estado activo, preparación de Docker Compose y mapa de dependencias y blast radius.
- `vps-incident-security-suite` — Security & Privacy — Audita seguridad de un VPS (firewall, SSH, fail2ban, actualizaciones) e investiga incidentes correlacionando procesos, conexiones, Docker, disco y memoria, sin aplicar cambios.
- `github-security-suite` — Security & Privacy — Audita seguridad de GitHub: code/secret scanning, advisories, dependencias, Dependabot, reportes privados y secretos, con planes de remediación.
- `github-cicd-governance` — Security & Privacy — Audita la gobernanza de CI/CD en GitHub Actions: permisos, environments, checks, merge queue, runners, OIDC, variables y despliegues manuales.
- `github-repo-governance` — Developer Tools — Audita y prepara configuración de repositorios GitHub: settings, CODEOWNERS, templates, labels, milestones, funding, Pages y rulesets de protección.
- `github-collab-activity` — Developer Tools — Resume actividad y colaboración en GitHub: Discussions, notificaciones, contribuidores, equipos, actividad temporal, tráfico y audit log administrativo.
- `github-branch-release-ops` — Developer Tools — Opera el ciclo de vida de ramas y despliegues en GitHub: ramas, firma de commits, despliegues, conflictos de merge y paquetes.
- `github-org-lifecycle` — Developer Tools — Audita configuración organizacional y ciclo de vida de repositorios en GitHub: settings de organización, archivado, migraciones, forks, webhooks, API y Projects.
- `linter-seo-geo-2026` — Content & Editorial — SEO/GEO pre-publication content validation.
- `marketplace-validator` — Marketplace & Quality — Claude Code and Codex manifest validation.
- `ai-prompt-workflow` — AI & Prompt Engineering — Designs and evaluates prompts with goals, context, constraints, and guardrails.
- `ux-accessibility-guide` — Accessibility & UX — Organizes UX and accessibility reviews with evidence and manual-test boundaries.
- `research-methods-guide` — Research & Evidence — Structures reproducible research with sources, evidence, uncertainty, and synthesis.
- `plugin-authoring` — Marketplace & Quality — Creates and validates plugins, manifests, synchronized catalog entries, and publication checks.
- `kdd-guide` — Developer Tools — Explains and applies Knowledge-Driven Development with OKF, CCDD, deterministic contracts, and validation gates.
- `design-system-auditor` — Design Systems — DESIGN.md, tokens, components, and validation contracts.
- `design-system-governance` — Design Systems — Maintains design contracts, component states, provenance, accessibility checks, and drift findings.
- `content-fact-checker` — Content & Editorial — Sources, dates, links, and claim attribution.
- `cv-job-tailor` — Content & Editorial — Tailors a real CV to a specific job offer with evidence traceability and anti-fabrication checks.
- `commercial-proposal-builder` — Content & Editorial — Builds commercial proposals from requirements with scope, pricing, and assumption integrity.
- `rfp-response-builder` — Content & Editorial — Responds to RFPs and tenders with compliance matrix, evidence, and open-item tracking.
- `github-issue-manager` — Developer Tools — Manages GitHub Issues with gh CLI, triage, and confirmation before mutations.
- `github-pr-manager` — Developer Tools — Prepares and reviews Pull Requests with checklists and validation evidence.
- `github-release-manager` — Developer Tools — Prepares GitHub releases, tags, and release notes with gh CLI.
- `github-actions-manager` — Developer Tools — Inspects GitHub Actions workflows, runs, jobs, and logs.
- `github-code-search` — Developer Tools — Searches GitHub code, commits, Issues, and Pull Requests reproducibly.
- `mercadopago-payment-manager` — Developer Tools — Prepares Mercado Pago Checkout Preference links with safety validation.
- `repo-quality-gate` — Marketplace & Quality — Repository readiness before commits, PRs, releases, or deployments.
- `technical-docs-linter` — Developer Tools — README, API docs, examples, commands, and links.
- `accessibility-auditor` — Accessibility & UX — HTML, ARIA, forms, contrast, and keyboard behavior.
- `privacy-risk-auditor` — Security & Privacy — PII, secrets, credentials, and privacy risks.
- `release-readiness` — Marketplace & Quality — Versioning, changelog, license, README, tests, and CI evidence.
- `prompt-contract-linter` — AI & Prompt Engineering — Prompt objectives, inputs, outputs, constraints, and acceptance criteria.
- `research-evidence-builder` — Research & Evidence — Research reports and evidence matrices.
- `brand-voice-validator` — Content & Editorial — Tone, vocabulary, claims, clarity, and editorial consistency.
- `api-contract-linter` — Developer Tools — OpenAPI paths, operations, responses, and examples.
- `web-performance-auditor` — Developer Tools — Loading resources and Core Web Vitals.
- `dependency-risk-auditor` — Security & Privacy — Dependencies, lockfiles, vulnerabilities, and supply-chain risks.
- `test-coverage-gate` — Marketplace & Quality — Test evidence, reports, coverage, and quality thresholds.
- `kdd-semver` — Developer Tools — Verifies Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 compliance with a deterministic instrument extracted via Knowledge-Driven Development.
- `kdd-stripe` — Security & Privacy — Verifica claves de Stripe embebidas en el codigo e Idempotency-Key en peticiones GET/DELETE, extraido con Knowledge-Driven Development.
- `kdd-rust-api` — Developer Tools — Verifica getters, Debug y ejemplos rustdoc de las Rust API Guidelines, extraido con Knowledge-Driven Development.
- `kdd-effective-go` — Developer Tools — Verifica indentacion con tabs, parentesis en control y llaves de Effective Go, extraido con Knowledge-Driven Development.
- `kdd-zen-of-python` — Developer Tools — Consulta honesta de los 19 aforismos del Zen de Python (0% instrumentado), extraido con Knowledge-Driven Development.
- `kdd-agile-manifesto` — Marketplace & Quality — Consulta honesta de los 4 valores y 12 principios del Manifiesto Agil (0% instrumentado), extraido con Knowledge-Driven Development.
- `kdd-tailwind` — Developer Tools — Verifica 10 tecnicas de Tailwind CSS v4 (instalacion, conflictos de utilidades, mobile-first, theme), extraido con Knowledge-Driven Development.
- `kdd-wcag` — Accessibility & UX — Verifica 10 criterios de exito de WCAG 2.2 (idioma, contraste, area de toque, etiquetas), extraido con Knowledge-Driven Development.
- `kdd-doce-factores` — Developer Tools — Verifica 10 tecnicas de The Twelve-Factor App: dependencias, config, servicios, puerto, paridad, daemonizacion, SIGTERM, logs, codebase y release ID.
- `kdd-htmx` — Developer Tools — Verifica HTML, capturas HTTP y plantillas contra 6 tecnicas medibles de la documentacion de htmx: mejora progresiva, indicador, CSRF, Vary, CSP y escapado, extraidas con Knowledge-Driven Development.
- `kdd-arquitectura-java` — Developer Tools — Verifica 8 reglas de arquitectura y codigo limpio: capas, excepciones, ISP, DI/Factory, AOP, COC, duplicacion (G5) y polimorfismo antes que if/else (G23), extraidas con Knowledge-Driven Development.
- `kdd-pep8` — Developer Tools — Verifica 28 reglas de PEP 8: indentacion, longitud de linea, imports, comillas, comentarios, docstrings y convenciones de nombres, extraidas con Knowledge-Driven Development.
- `kdd-scrum-xp` — Marketplace & Quality — Verifica 12 tecnicas de Scrum y eXtreme Programming con instrumento real (cadencia, TDD, repo unico, Clean Code) y documenta 22 tecnicas mas que requieren tablero, calendario o CI reales, extraidas con Knowledge-Driven Development.
- `kdd-codigo-limpio` — Developer Tools — Verifica 30 heuristicas de Clean Code: comentarios, funciones, principios generales G, nombres, pruebas y profundidad de cadena, extraidas con Knowledge-Driven Development.
- `kdd-estilo-google` — Content & Editorial — Verifica 42 reglas del Google developer documentation style guide: puntuacion, numeros/unidades/fechas, encabezados, codigo/CLI, voz/tiempo verbal y vocabulario declarado, extraidas con Knowledge-Driven Development.
- `vps-ssh-manager` — Developer Tools — Conecta a VPS propios por SSH con preflight, verificacion de host key y confirmacion antes de cambios.
- `supabase-selfhosted-observer` — Developer Tools — Observa contenedores, healthchecks, versiones y recursos de Supabase self-hosted por SSH sin exponer secretos.
- `supabase-database-manager` — Developer Tools — Diagnostica PostgreSQL de Supabase self-hosted con consultas seguras y confirmación antes de mutaciones.
- `supabase-service-manager` — Developer Tools — Diagnostica y opera servicios Docker Compose de Supabase con rollback y confirmación explícita.
- `supabase-config-auditor` — Security & Privacy — Audita configuración, puertos, volúmenes y variables sin revelar secretos.
- `supabase-backup-manager` — Security & Privacy — Planifica y verifica backups y recuperaciones de PostgreSQL con retención, cifrado y rollback.
- `supabase-upgrade-manager` — Developer Tools — Evalúa upgrades de Supabase con compatibilidad, backup, ventana y rollback.
- `docker-vps-observer` — Developer Tools — Observa daemon, contenedores, healthchecks, recursos y puertos Docker por SSH sin mutaciones.
- `docker-service-manager` — Developer Tools — Planifica cambios Docker Compose con preflight, confirmación, ventana y rollback.
- `docker-image-manager` — Developer Tools — Audita imágenes, digests y espacio recuperable con guardas contra limpieza destructiva.
- `docker-storage-auditor` — Security & Privacy — Audita volúmenes, redes, mounts y exposición Docker sin leer secretos.
- `docker-log-diagnostics` — Developer Tools — Correlaciona logs acotados, eventos, reinicios y healthchecks para investigar incidentes.
- `tls-domain-manager` — Security & Privacy — Audita certificados, dominios, SNI, redirecciones y reverse proxies HTTPS.
- `firewall-policy-manager` — Security & Privacy — Audita UFW, iptables y nftables y prepara cambios con rollback.
- `system-update-planner` — Developer Tools — Planifica actualizaciones de paquetes y kernel con ventana y reinicio requerido.
- `cron-automation-auditor` — Developer Tools — Audita cron y systemd timers con historial y fallos sin ejecutar tareas.
- `secrets-exposure-auditor` — Security & Privacy — Detecta indicios de secretos en configuración y procesos sin mostrar valores.
- `nginx-reverse-proxy-manager` — Developer Tools — Audita Nginx, hosts, upstreams, headers, TLS y rutas públicas.
- `database-operations-manager` — Developer Tools — Diagnostica PostgreSQL, MySQL y Redis con consultas seguras y confirmación.
- `supabase-policy-security-auditor` — Security & Privacy — Audita RLS, Storage, Auth/JWT y Edge Functions/Realtime de Supabase self-hosted en modo lectura sin exponer secretos.
- `supabase-migration-drift-auditor` — Security & Privacy — Audita migraciones aplicadas, archivos en disco y catálogos PostgreSQL de Supabase self-hosted para detectar drift de schema sin aplicar ni revertir migraciones y sin leer datos de usuario ni secretos.
- `supabase-pgcron-auditor` — Developer Tools — Audita jobs pg_cron de Supabase self-hosted en modo lectura listando cron.job y cron.job_run_details, detectando jobs fallidos, pausados, duplicados, frecuencias peligrosas y comandos que expongan secretos o muten fuera de alcance.

## Design System Analyses

Published analyses are reusable results rather than generator plugins. Each analysis may include a `DESIGN.md` source of truth, `design-system.json`, `validation-report.json`, and an HTML preview. The catalog presents these previews inside the marketplace interface.

## Instructions for AI agents

Before modifying this repository, inspect the relevant marketplace manifest and plugin directory. Keep `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`, `.agents/plugins/marketplace.json`, plugin manifests, and the catalog metadata synchronized. Do not describe an analysis as an official brand system unless its provenance explicitly supports that claim.

When adding a plugin, use a lowercase hyphenated directory under `plugins/`, add both platform manifests when cross-platform support is intended, reuse shared skills under `skills/`, and run the repository validation commands documented in `README.md` before publishing.

## Installation

In Claude Code, add `MauricioPerera/thehumanintheloop-marketplace-codex` and install `linter-seo-geo-2026@thehumanintheloop-marketplace-claude`. In Codex, register the `.agents/plugins` marketplace and install `linter-seo-geo-2026`. Both platforms consume the same plugin directory and shared skills.

For another plugin, replace `linter-seo-geo-2026` with its exact identifier from the catalog. In Claude Desktop, use `+ → Plugins → Add plugin`; `/plugin` commands belong to the interactive Claude Code terminal.

## Source and updates

- Repository: https://github.com/MauricioPerera/thehumanintheloop-marketplace-codex
- Catalog: https://mauricioperera.github.io/thehumanintheloop-marketplace-codex/
